changes: B/b now expands billions between millions and trillions.
Internal journal date dividers are thin; entry boundaries stay thick.
Other-month warnings show entered dates and the full recording month, wrapping with space before action buttons.
Post Entry Enter finishes editing in the same cell; arrow keys then choose the next cell.
Double-click selects cell contents and words without clearing accounts; completed login passwords are cleared and account fields are marked as non-login fields.
Multiple Dates carries the main date into existing and new rows; hidden single-date rows also follow the main picker.
